crossRefs.note: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their bags with grain, and to restore each man’s money into his sack, and to give…
They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed from there.
He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each…
Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word…

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan.
translations.bsb: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do as follows: Load your animals and return to the land of Canaan.
translations.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
translations.asv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye: lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
